Water requirements
The water required to initially flil the system side cooling loop must be reasonably clean, bacteria-free water
(<100 CFU/ml) such as de-mineralized water, reverse osmosis water, de-ionized water, or distilled water. The
water must be flitered with an in-line 50 micron fliter (approximately 288 mesh). The water must be treated
with anti-biological and anti-corrosion measures. Environment quality must be maintain over the lifetime of
the system to receive warranty and support on afefcting components. For more information please see
Lenovo Neptune Direct Water-Cooling Standards.
